author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Windows K2. This project is drummed up to save the rapidly tanking reputation of the largest Operating System in the world. Is it enough to save it? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: They're So Desperate Now...
